capabilities: Generate custom mock tests by subject, topic, difficulty, or year
Simulate timed full-screen examinations with auto-submit
Report score, accuracy, and time statistics after each test
Review submitted questions against correct answers
Track progress and weak or strong areas on a dashboard
extras: Depends on resources downloaded through the GATE Manager plugin (question papers, images, and a PYQs pattern book) which must be kept up to date; not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Unlike traditional PDF collections, this plugin turns your question bank into an interactive exam environment
problem: GATE aspirants keep previous-year questions as static PDF collections and have no interactive, timed exam environment inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: To use this plugin, first install the GATE Manager Plugin.

summary: Exam simulator that generates mock tests from GATE past-year questions with a timed exam interface, analytics, and progress tracking.
